summary_schedule_after_connection.prompt: Use the serial_numbers string/array supplied in this schedule's task parameters. Flag stale data, failures and resource pressure without discarding successful results from a mixed batch. Use actual source/observation intervals and recommend evidence-based improvements for human review. Do not infer serials from examples or unrelated cache entries.
